description: Source code implementing Dobby container management within WPEFramework, including classes for container administration and container instances, with functions for starting, stopping, and querying container states.

classes.name: DobbyContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing container lifecycle via Dobby IPC and proxy, including container creation, destruction, and status checks.

classes.name: DobbyContainer
classes.description: Represents a Dobby container instance, providing methods to start, stop, and query container status and information.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on configuration files found in search paths.

methods.name: DestroyContainer
methods.description: Stops and removes a container by name.

methods.name: ContainerNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a container with the given name is already running.

methods.name: containerStopCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops, used to fulfill stop promises.

methods.name: DobbyContainer
methods.description: Manages individual container lifecycle, including start, stop, and status queries.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of the container's main process.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory info for the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns CPU/processor info for the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces associated with the container.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.
